questions.question: The source describes labelled horizontal bars and bar charts as types of histogram, although standard statistical usage distinguishes categorical bar charts from histograms of numerical intervals. Please review this terminology and whether the area/frequency statement should explicitly assume equal bin widths. The source account is retained.
